label: Exploring differences in protein cargo of extracellular vesicles from ME/CFS patient plasma compared to healthy controls.
summary: Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS) is a chronic and debilitating disease characterized by post-exertional malaise, fatigue and pain. Yet, its underlying biological mechanisms remain poorly understood. Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are nanoparticles carrying biological cargo and are involved in cell-cell communication.
